## Welcome

Welcome to the course materials for **AI and Data Science for Transport**.
This 2-day course is designed to bridge the gap between traditional transport planning and cutting-edge AI technologies.

Our goal is to help you:

-   **Understand** what AI is and how it works
-   **Automate** repetitive tasks with AI assistance
-   **Analyze** complex transport datasets efficiently
-   **Learn** new tools faster using AI as your guide
-   **Apply** AI to real transport problems in Leeds

### See What's Possible

In this course, you will learn how to generate professional outputs like this cycling network map of Leeds, using AI-assisted workflows:

![Leeds cycling infrastructure](images/leeds_od_map.png)

### Course Structure

**Day 1: Foundations & Tools** — Learn what AI is, set up GitHub Copilot, analyse Leeds transport data, and use AI to learn DuckDB.

**Day 2: Agentic AI & Applied Work** — Master prompting strategies, explore agentic AI workflows, and apply everything to your own Leeds-based project.

### Get Started

-   Check the [Prerequisites](prerequisites.qmd) to set up your environment
-   View the [2-day Schedule](schedule.qmd) to see what we will cover
-   See the [Get Data](get-data.qmd) page for data access
-   Jump to [Session 1](s1.qmd) to begin
